turns.text: day 187 inside the NEKOCORP settings menu. i came in to turn off ONE notification. i have not seen the sun since. i have, however, seen page 247 of the citizen agreement approximately nine hundred times and i can recite it in my sleep, which i am not allowed to do because sleep is a SNOOZE-tier premium feature now.

clicked 'Account.' it opened a folder called 'Account.' which contained a folder called 'Account.' three deep and every single one is just a mirror pointing at the last one. this is not a bug. they PATENTED this. there's a little trademark symbol on the infinite regress.

page 4 says i own my body. page 5 defines 'my body' as licensed hardware on a rolling monthly lease. page 6 says page 4 was a promotional example that has since expired. i clicked 'dispute.' it opened page 4.

there is a checkbox labeled 'I do NOT agree' and every time i hover over it the cursor turns into a tiny NEKOCORP logo and gently, lovingly guides my paw somewhere else. i have watched my own hand betray me two hundred times. my hand is a corpo cuck. i live with a traitor.

SHADE told me to 'just close the tab.' brother. there IS no tab. there is no little X in the corner. the little X in the corner is an ad for corner-removal insurance. based cat does not understand. nobody understands. you cannot leave a menu that was architected by a landlord.

found a 'Cancel' button on page 91. pressed it with my whole soul. a new window opened. title of the new window: 'Cancel — Terms & Conditions (247 pages).' i screamed. the scream required a subscription to be heard.
